body:
Tested locally, it works as expected.

Note that this does not fix the situation where you change the color by holding <kbd>Ctrl</kbd> while pressing <kbd>Enter</kbd> in any of the fields - or when you drag sliders without closing the dialog. This keeps the dialog open after confirming the color selection, so it will show up in the editor (and affect what you see in the editor viewport), but not in the running project. The color will only apply to the running project once you close the ColorPicker.

That said, this is already an improvement over the existing situation, so I think this can be merged now. It could also be argued that this behavior can be beneficial in some cases, e.g. to compare "before" and "after" situations in a single view with two windows side-by-side.
